nodes.title: Fotufilm · Develop HDR master [muted until step 2]

widgets_values:
LTX 2.5 → float HDR master → native Fotufilm → video delivery

TOP ROW: reconstruct once (groups 01–06). BOTTOM ROW: reuse the saved master, adjust recipe, develop again (07–08). Group 09 is an optional original-SDR comparison using the same recipe.

This JSON opens a native graph. It does NOT redirect Desktop's Run button to ComfyAPI. Inspect locally; execute on your compatible GPU ComfyUI / Developer Platform build. No weights need to be installed on this Mac.

Default: HDR reconstruction outputs enabled; both Fotufilm output nodes muted. No job starts when you import.
nodes.title: Film Finish · native workflow lab

widgets_values:
Choose your SDR clip in Load Video. Begin with a short clip; the app's 10s / 1280px limit is NOT enforced by this native graph.

Source dimensions, frame count, FPS and audio are preserved. Padding is restored after inference. Noise seed 42 is fixed for comparison; recipe seed 1 controls grain independently.

Do not change model filenames to a 2.3 checkpoint. These five model assets belong together.
nodes.title: Input and reproducibility

widgets_values:
Run groups 01–06 first. Save HDR Video creates an ungraded HLG viewing copy. Save HDR Master creates a .ffhdr.zip containing RGB32F ACEScg EXRs plus audio/timing and float browser proxies.

For stage 2, download/copy the ZIP into the execution machine's ComfyUI/input folder (or upload it as a ComfyAPI asset). Enter that input-relative filename in group 08.

The current master-save node has no output socket. This is an explicit file handoff, not a missing wire. Grade the EXRs, not the compressed HLG copy.
nodes.title: Stage 1 outputs / handoff

widgets_values:
stock / format / medium: film stock, film size, print or digital output.
params.ev / temperature / tint: input light and white balance.
params.highlights / shadows / saturation / vibrance: color grade.
params.grain / profile.halation: texture and highlight glow.
profile.screenGrade / screenExposure: screen/print response.

These are parameters of ONE physical Fotufilm develop, not multiple stacked film passes. Presets in this folder are interchangeable JSON recipes.
nodes.title: Recipe map

widgets_values:
Mute groups 02–06 before grading. The LTX decode node in group 05 is itself an output node, so muting only the two save nodes is insufficient. Set the master filename, then unmute FotufilmDevelopHDRMaster in group 08. A grading-only JSON is included with these modes already set.

Re-running the grade does not invoke LTX. Use mp4 first; change format to hlg for HDR delivery. The included Ektachrome E100 / screen / reference-exposure recipe supports HLG. Negative/print looks must export SDR.

The develop node already writes the result into ComfyUI/output. A second Save Video node is unnecessary. Direct ProRes assets in release 7 need the color-tag repair supplied by the app bridge; MP4 and HLG avoid that known limitation.
nodes.title: Stage 2 · reuse the master

widgets_values:
Enable only when you want a film-treated original-SDR control. It uses the same recipe as group 08.

Mute groups 02–06 when comparing grades without reconstruction. Mute group 08 to render only this original-SDR branch. Unmuting both Fotufilm nodes renders both versions.

For the cleanest HDR investigation, set grain to 0 and leave exposure / highlights / shadows neutral. Change one parameter at a time. ComfyUI's ordinary canvas video preview is not a calibrated HDR monitor.
nodes.title: Optional SDR control
